transcription: When in Osaka, you must eat takoyaki, so here are three places to get it at. The first is wana kaka. There's always a line so the takoyaki is always being made hot and fresh. Emphasis on hot. Slightly crispy on the outside and big pieces of octopus make these one of my favorites. Next is achi chi honten. I'd recommend getting their show you negi takoyaki. They use show you instead of the takoyaki sauce, so these aren't quite as heavy as your typical takoyaki. Especially with all of the fresh green onion. Last is kukuru, one of the most famous spots. They're boasting having the number one takoyaki. I love that they use lots of bonito flakes, their takoyaki is super soft and satisfying. Also, don't miss these takoyaki snacks in this month's Lost in Japan crepe.

#japan #fashion #outfit #clothing".
transcription: Ungay keeping one of the best clothing stores in Japan that you have to visit. If you're a fan of Uniclo, but you're looking for something a little bit more premium, then this is the perfect brand for you. They have a similar minimal Japanese aesthetic, but with a more sophisticated premium touch, the best part is that everything is made in Japan. And if you're a short king like me, the fit is quite literally perfect. If jeans have a pleated design with a wide silhouette, your cargos have a nice flowy structure with very wide pockets, and your shirts have a relaxed silky smooth finish that I absolutely love. Your brand is called Public Tokyo and I highly recommend you visit their main branch in Harajuku. What do you guys think?
